30A Escapes presents… “Sea Glass Cottage”, your coastal escape tucked inside the gated beauty of Watersound West. Designed for relaxation and connection, this 4 Bed, 4 Bath home sleeps 11 and invites you to slow down with breezy porches, a chef’s kitchen, and sun-drenched living spaces. Wake to ocean air, bike scenic nature trails, lounge steps from the community pool, and stroll the private beach walk-over to sugar-white sands. This is where coastal living feels effortless and memories come naturally. Learn more below…👇


★☆ HIGHLIGHTS ☆★

✔ Gated Watersound West Community: Enjoy peace, privacy, and natural beauty in one of 30A’s most sought-after gated coastal neighborhoods.
✔ Steps to the Community Pool: Spend sunny days lounging or cooling off with the community pool conveniently located just steps from the home.
✔ Private Beach Walk-Over Near Deer Lake State Park: Take an easy stroll to quiet, sugar-white sands and enjoy a more peaceful beach experience along the Emerald Coast.
✔ Sleeps 11 Comfortably with 4 Bedrooms + Twin Nook: Thoughtfully designed for families and groups, offering spacious suites and flexible sleeping arrangements.
✔ Spacious Chef’s Kitchen: Stainless steel appliances, ample prep space, and bar seating make this kitchen perfect for gathering and shared meals.
✔ Screened-In Back Porch with Grill: Relax and dine outdoors in the screened porch, ideal for evening meals and laid-back coastal nights.
✔ Multiple Outdoor Living Spaces: Enjoy a welcoming front porch, private balcony, and screened porch designed for relaxation and connection.
✔ Nature Trails Throughout the Community: Explore scenic paths just outside your door, perfect for walking, biking, and soaking in the surroundings.
✔ 6 Bikes Included: Easily explore 30A, nearby beach towns, and scenic routes at your own pace.

★☆ LIVING AREA ☆★

A bright, open floor plan creates a comfortable and inviting living space designed for relaxed coastal living. The main living area offers ample seating for gathering, unwinding, or enjoying a movie night after the beach. Natural light fills the room, highlighting the coastal finishes and creating a warm, welcoming atmosphere. Just off the living area, a Twin Nook provides a convenient additional sleeping option, while the front porch extends the living space outdoors for morning coffee or evening relaxation.

✔ Open-concept living area with ample seating and flat-screen TV
✔ Comfortable furnishings designed for relaxation and conversation
✔ Seamless flow between living, dining, and kitchen spaces
✔ Twin Nook off the living area, ideal for 1 guest
✔ Front porch with generous seating for morning coffee or evening wind-downs

★☆ KITCHEN AND DINING ☆★

The heart of Sea Glass Cottage, this spacious chef’s kitchen blends comfort and functionality with a clean coastal feel. Thoughtfully designed for both everyday meals and shared moments, it offers plenty of room to prep, cook, and gather without missing a conversation. The open layout flows effortlessly into the dining area, making it easy to linger over meals after a day at the beach or enjoy relaxed mornings together.

✔ Chef’s kitchen equipped with stainless steel appliances and generous counter space
✔ Bar seating for 2, perfect for casual breakfasts or keeping the cook company
✔ Dining table with seating for 8, ideal for family meals and group dinners
✔ Flat-screen TV in the kitchen area for added convenience
✔ Open-concept design that connects seamlessly to the living area for easy entertaining

★☆ OUTDOOR OASIS ☆★

Enjoy Florida’s outdoor lifestyle with several inviting spaces designed for easy, relaxed living. Start your mornings on the screened-in back porch with coffee and coastal breezes, spend afternoons by the community pool just steps away, and unwind in the evenings with outdoor dining or quiet time on the private balcony. With scenic trails and beach access nearby, enjoying the outdoors feels natural and effortless.

✔ Community pool just steps from the home, perfect for cooling off and lounging
✔ Screened-in back porch with al fresco dining for 4, ideal for relaxed meals
✔ Gas grill for easy outdoor cooking
✔ Front porch with ample seating for morning coffee or evening conversations
✔ Private balcony off the Primary Suite with seating for 2
✔ Gated community with scenic nature trails for walking and biking

★☆ BEDROOMS AND BATHROOMS ☆★

Each bedroom offers a comfortable retreat, thoughtfully arranged to provide privacy and rest for every guest. With multiple en-suite options and flexible sleeping arrangements, this home is well-suited for families and groups traveling together.

1st Floor:
✔ Twin Nook: Cozy sleeping space for 1 guest, conveniently located off the living area
✔ Full Bathroom: Single vanity and walk-in shower

2nd Floor:
✔ Primary King Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV, private balcony access, and En-suite with dual vanities, soaking tub, and walk-in shower
✔ King Guest Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV, and En-suite with single vanity and walk-in shower
✔ Full Guest Suite: 2 Full beds and flat-screen TV
✔ King Guest Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV, and En-suite with single vanity and shower/tub combo

★☆ LOCATION AND COMMUNITY ☆★

Watersound West is renowned for its exclusivity, stunning natural beauty and access to 30A’s top attractions. Stroll over the dunes to the sugar white sands of the Emerald Coast or cruise the scenic route on one of the provided bikes. Nearby attractions include Deer Lake State Park, boutique shopping in Seaside, and waterfront dining options in the vibrant 30A community.

✔ WaterSound Private Beach Walk-Over - Just steps away, offering serene ocean views and the perfect place to unwind with the sound of waves.
✔ Deer Lake State Park - A peaceful haven of untouched nature, ideal for a relaxing escape into scenic trails.
✔ Seagrove Beach - A charming spot, full of laid-back vibes and beautiful sandy shores.
✔ Seaside Town Center - A vibrant, picturesque community with unique shops, dining, and a lively coastal atmosphere.

★☆ OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ☆★

✔ To ensure a smooth and secure stay, guests are required to complete the 30A Escapes Rental Agreement after booking. This agreement outlines important house rules and helps us provide the best experience possible. Once your reservation is confirmed, you will receive a link via the booking platform to sign the agreement. After it is completed, we will send your official booking confirmation email with all the details you need. If you have any questions, feel free to reach out to us directly – we are always happy to help!
✔ Travel insurance is NOT included in your quote. It can be purchased upon booking, added to your reservation by the final payment date, or obtained independently.
✔ We do NOT accept wire transfers for payment. (AMEX, Visa, and MasterCard ONLY)
✔ This property has 6 bikes for guest use. To utilize the bikes, a waiver must be signed before the code is provided to the guest. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes.
✔ To see a virtual tour of this home, please visit https://www.insidemaps.com/app/walkthrough-tour/?p=hLjy9n0GEb&embedded=true

☆★ YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ☆★

At 30A Escapes, we are committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.

★☆ BOOK TODAY AND START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ☆★
